# APX 550W

Built to Last with High-Quality Components Whisper-Quiet 120mm Fan Unleashes Precision Power with Dominance 12V Rail & DC-to-DC Technology Full Voltage Compatibility Robust Protection & 5-Year Warranty

Discover the MONTECH APX white-label series: your ultimate gaming companion. Engineered with high-end components and whisper-quiet fan performance, APX redefines excellence in the white-label market. Featuring a cutting-edge DC-to-DC design, it eradicates compatibility worries, setting a new standard for white-label power. Elevate your gaming prowess with APX.

Built to Last with High-Quality Components

 APX PSUs Ensure Stable, Reliable Performance with High-Quality Components.

Experience cool performance and silent operation with APX, featuring a whisper-quiet 120mm Hydraulic Bearing Fan. Keep your system running smoothly without the noise.

APX's robust +12V rails, deliver superior power under any system load. With advanced DC-to-DC converters, APX ensures efficient and precise voltage regulation, providing optimal power supply for all electronic devices across diverse applications. Power up with APX for reliability and performance like never before.

APX power supply is engineered to deliver consistent power across diverse electrical systems.

Elevate your chassis thermal efficiency with the APX series, boasting flat cables designed to enhance airflow and optimize heat dissipation. Experience improved performance and effortless cable routing for a streamlined setup.

Experience industrial-grade power protection with APX, featuring all six essential mechanisms to ensure stable and safe system operation. Backed by a 5-year warranty, APX guarantees long-term reliability for worry-free usage. Power up with confidence with APX. "Warranty service does not extend to power supplies used for cryptocurrency mining."

The simple and convenient fully modular design allows users to connect only the needed cables, achieving clean cable management with more space for airflow.
